activity.role: Abolitionist and Harpers Ferry raid leader
activity.notes: The U.S. National Park Service documents John Brown's leadership of the Harpers Ferry raid from the night of 16 October 1859 until his capture by U.S. Marines on 18 October 1859. ATLAS stores this exact, source-bounded episode as his representative Activity and does not turn his entire abolitionist career or later symbolic legacy into a synthetic continuous rail.

sources.title: John Brown - U.S. National Park Service
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service states that Brown and his followers captured the U.S. Armory, Arsenal and Rifle Factory at Harpers Ferry on the night of 16 October 1859 and that Brown was captured by U.S. Marines on 18 October 1859.

sources.title: John Brown's Raid - U.S. National Park Service
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service provides a detailed chronology of Brown's October 1859 Harpers Ferry raid and its immediate suppression.
